We know how important your music is for you, so our simple but powerful Rocket Music Player will make this an enjoyable Music Player experience. Enjoy your music with the best music player.

Powerful Music Player with Fantastic Features!

Rocket Music Player Features: 🎵 Display by song, album, artist, playlist, composer, genre, and more! 🎵 Band graphic equalizer including Bass Booster 🎵 30+ themes 🎵 Embedded lyrics 🎵 Tag Editing 🎵 Play many formats (wav, ogg, mp3, 3gp, mp4, m4a, alac, tta, ape, mpc, FLAC, WV, and WMA ) 🎵 Batch selection – for selecting multiple songs at once to add to playlist, eq 🎵 Custom lock screen 🎵 Sleep timer 🎵 Podcast bookmarks 🎵 Scrobbling support 🎵 Chromecast support 🎵 Android Auto support Powerful & beautiful Music Player Enjoy your music with a beautiful user interface. You can choose a color theme or player theme you like in our MP3 player. Rocket Music Player - Mp3 Player is a perfect choice for you. Fantastic Audio & mp3 Player by JRT Studio! Discover beautiful themes and personalize Audio Player to fit all your needs! Your music sounds & looks gorgeous with our music player. Subscribe to cloud features for: •  Playlist backup and restore between devices •  Ratings and play count backup and restore Combine with iSyncr for metadata syncing back to iTunes •  Ratings •  Play counts •  Playlist changes •  Sync embedded lyrics •  Many more features

Enjoy music like never before with Android's most advanced Music Player!

Unique Music Player - Mp3 Player Rocket Music Player became a default app for Android Audio Player throughout its history. Our Music Player is so rich in features that it's got a whole set of nicknames from our fantastic users: Audio Player for Android, Reproductor de Musica, Mp3 Player, Offline Music, or Rocket Player. Regardless of what you call it, once you install Rocket Music Player, you receive an intelligent tool, making listening to music even more enjoyable!
